name: Puppeteer Browser MCP Server
shortDescription: Full headless browser automation, web page rendering, screenshot capture, form filling, and JavaScript execution.
longDescription: Empower LLMs with live web browsing capabilities, interacting with dynamic JavaScript-rendered single-page applications, clicking elements, taking full-page screenshots, and extracting DOM structures.
author: modelcontextprotocol

tools.name: puppeteer_navigate
tools.description: Navigate the browser to any target URL.

tools.name: puppeteer_screenshot
tools.description: Capture a screenshot of current viewport or specific CSS selector.

tools.name: puppeteer_click
tools.description: Click an element identified by CSS selector.

tools.name: puppeteer_fill
tools.description: Fill input values into form fields.

tools.name: puppeteer_evaluate
tools.description: Execute arbitrary JavaScript code in the browser console.

prerequisites: Chromium / Google Chrome installed or downloaded via Puppeteer
